title: Resolve the repository independently of npm cwd
summary: Default the server to the repository containing the POC module so the documented npm prefix command loads the root artifact.
rationale: npm executes package scripts from the package directory. Artifact discovery should use the installed project layout rather than assume the caller's process working directory.

decisions.summary: Default to the repository two levels above the server module and allow REPOSITORY_ROOT to override it.
decisions.rationale: The bundled POC works from any caller directory while retaining an explicit escape hatch for reuse or tests.

failedAttempts.approach: Use process.cwd() as the default repository root while documenting npm start --prefix poc.
failedAttempts.outcome: npm changed the working directory to poc, and /api/review returned a missing manifest error.
failedAttempts.lesson: A packaged local tool needs explicit repository discovery or a module-relative default; launch instructions alone are not a reliable root contract.

validation.summary: Covers module-relative repository discovery when npm runs tests from the poc package directory.
The documented npm start command loaded six finalized stages, the active working stage, and passed artifact validation.
After finalization, the documented package startup resolves and processes all seven canonical stages.
